description.zh: 债券是未来现金流序列；价格是逐笔贴现再加总。利率升、价格跌：新买家只按新利率出价，旧债券必须跌价到同样收益率。
description.en: A bond is a sequence of future cash flows; its price is each payment discounted and added up. Rates up, price down: new buyers pay only at the new rate, so the old bond must fall until it yields the same.

reason.zh: 债券价格就是未来现金按利率折到今天的现值——没有利率这个折现率，这课的定价无从算起。
reason.en: A bond's price is future cash discounted to today at the interest rate — without that discount rate, this lesson's pricing has nothing to compute from.

reason.zh: 利率一变，未来每笔现金的折现分母都变——整条现金流重算一遍，价格就跟着动。
reason.en: When the rate changes, the discount denominator of every future payment changes — the whole cash-flow stream is recomputed, and the price moves with it.

reason.zh: 一张债券值多少钱，不看票面看未来：把以后每笔票息和本金都按利率折到今天，加起来就是它的价格。
reason.en: What a bond is worth is not its face value but its future: discount every future coupon and the principal back to today at the rate, and their sum is its price.

reason.zh: 新债券按新利率付息，老债券只有跌价、让自己的收益率追上新利率，才卖得掉。
reason.en: New bonds pay the new rate, so an old bond must fall in price until its own yield catches up with the new rate — only then will anyone buy it.

reason.zh: 任何投资的回报都要先和利率比：钱放着不动也能拿到的收益，就是其他选择必须跨过的门槛。
reason.en: Any investment's return must first be compared with the interest rate: what money earns by sitting still is the hurdle every other choice must clear.

title.zh: 利率上升，债券价格为什么跌？
title.en: Why do bond prices fall when rates rise?

ask.zh: 利率在债券定价里起什么作用？
ask.en: What role does the rate play in pricing a bond?

ask.zh: 利率上升，债券价格为什么跌？
ask.en: Why do bond prices fall when rates rise?

ask.zh: 旧债券凭什么必须跌价？
ask.en: Why must an old bond fall in price?
